acceptanceCriteria: `npx tsc --noEmit -p extensions/vscode` exits 0 on main with the repository's locked dependencies.
The fix keeps MCPV0-031 behavior: a capped impact result still reports its omitted evidence/reference rows in uncertainty, covered by an extension test.
body:
Observed 2026-10-09 on origin/main 1120e565 (found while moving the version tuple to rc.3, PR beamfall/corvint#716; not caused by it).

Reproduction: in extensions/vscode with node_modules installed, `npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p .`
Actual: `src/model.ts(158,37): error TS2532: Object is possibly 'undefined'.` at `${results[index].id}` inside the MCPV0-031 rawResults.forEach loop (indexed array access under noUncheckedIndexedAccess).
Expected: type-check passes. The extension's 85 node tests still pass, so this is a compile-gate failure, not an observed runtime defect.
title: VS Code extension tsc fails with TS2532 at src/model.ts:158 on main
